notes: בַּעֲוֺן is tagged R with no article token, so the ASV's the before iniquity is supplied and joins the noun it determines (rules 15, 29).
מְקַלְלִים is rendered by the light verb did bring with its complement a curse, headed on curse under rule 44.
בָּם is promoted to a bare English object (restrained them), leaving the preposition unrepresented under rule 40.
